description: Implement MissionDebriefScreen component (6 sections including Recharts resource history charts), update the router /debrief route with a RequireMissionStarted guard, fix the mission-store test's endMission call, and add all new tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (requires ResourceHistoryPoint and resourceHistory from the store/hook).
steps: 1. Create src/features/mission-debrief/MissionDebriefScreen.tsx. Import useMissionControl from @/hooks/useMissionControl, useMissionStore from @store/mission-store, useNavigate from react-router-dom, and named Recharts components (LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer) from 'recharts'. The component takes no props. Read all data from useMissionControl(). Add a resetMission action from useMissionStore. Implement 6 sections: (1) Outcome banner — colour-coded div based on missionOutcome (success=green, partial=yellow, failure=red), shows outcome label, planet name, and mission day count; (2) Score breakdown — labelled rows for each MissionScore field; show loading placeholder if missionScore is null; (3) Resource history charts — 4 ResponsiveContainer+LineChart panels for oxygen, water, food, energy using resourceHistory array as data; if resourceHistory is empty, show 'No mission data recorded'; (4) Decision log — scrollable list from decisionLog, each showing missionDay, action.type, resultSummary, wasOptimal badge; show 'No decisions recorded.' if empty; (5) Learning summary — static text keyed on missionOutcome with comment AI-007 placeholder; (6) Navigation — Play Again button calling resetMission() then navigate('/'); Keep component under 300 lines; extract ResourceChart, ScoreRow, DecisionLogItem as named local sub-components with typed props interfaces if needed.

2. Update src/app/router.tsx: (a) add import for MissionDebriefScreen from '@/features/mission-debrief/MissionDebriefScreen'; (b) add RequireMissionStarted guard component reading missionStarted from useMissionStore — redirects to '/' if false; (c) replace the /debrief PlaceholderScreen route element with <RequireSetup><RequireMissionStarted><MissionDebriefScreen /></RequireMissionStarted></RequireSetup>

3. Update tests/unit/store/mission-store.test.ts: (a) fix the existing 'endMission sets missionActive to false and stores score' test to pass an empty array as second arg: missionStore.getState().endMission(score, []) and add expect(missionStore.getState().decisionLog).toEqual([]); (b) add test 'INITIAL_MISSION_STATE has empty resourceHistory'; (c) add test 'updateFromSimResult appends a ResourceHistoryPoint per call' — call updateFromSimResult twice with mockResults for days 1 and 2, assert length=2 and days match; (d) update the existing resetMission test to also assert resourceHistory equals []

4. Create tests/unit/simulation/resource-history.test.ts with 6 tests using describe('resourceHistory in missionStore'): (1) resourceHistory starts empty in INITIAL_MISSION_STATE; (2) each updateFromSimResult call appends one entry; (3) calling 3 times yields length 3; (4) entries preserve missionDay order [1,2,3]; (5) entry values match nextState resources exactly (oxygen_kg, water_kg, food_kg, energy_kWh, cumulativeRadiation_mSv); (6) resetMission empties resourceHistory. Import missionStore and INITIAL_MISSION_STATE from @store/mission-store. Use beforeEach to reset store to INITIAL_MISSION_STATE.

5. Create tests/unit/features/MissionDebriefScreen.test.tsx with 7 tests using describe('MissionDebriefScreen'). Import render, screen from @testing-library/react. Import MemoryRouter from react-router-dom. Import MissionDebriefScreen from @/features/mission-debrief/MissionDebriefScreen. Import missionStore, INITIAL_MISSION_STATE from @store/mission-store. Import useAppStore from @store/app-store. In beforeEach: reset missionStore and useAppStore to initial state. Wrap all renders in <MemoryRouter>. Tests: (1) renders without crashing when missionScore is null (default state); (2) displays success text for outcome=success; (3) displays failure text for outcome=failure; (4) displays score breakdown rows when missionScore is set (check for 'Base Score' and the finalScore number); (5) shows 'No mission data recorded' when resourceHistory empty; (6) shows decision log entry text when decisionLog has an entry; (7) shows 'No decisions recorded' when decisionLog is empty.
acceptance_criteria: MissionDebriefScreen renders without crashing when missionScore is null or resourceHistory is []
All 6 sections render: outcome banner, score breakdown, resource charts, decision log, learning summary, navigation button
Play Again button calls resetMission and navigates to '/'
/debrief route redirects to '/' when missionStarted=false (RequireMissionStarted guard)
npm run build exits 0 — zero TypeScript and Vite errors
npm run test -- --run — all 75 baseline + at minimum 16 new tests pass (3 updated/new store tests + 6 resource-history tests + 7 component tests), total >= 91
verification: npm run build — must exit 0 with zero TS and zero Vite errors
npm run test -- --run — must exit 0, all tests pass, total >= 91
findings: All 5 implementation steps completed. MissionDebriefScreen created with 6 sections (outcome banner, score breakdown, Recharts resource history charts, decision log, learning summary, navigation). Router updated with RequireMissionStarted guard replacing /debrief placeholder. mission-store tests updated: endMission call fixed, 2 new resourceHistory tests added, resetMission test updated to assert resourceHistory=[]. 6 new resource-history unit tests created. 7 new MissionDebriefScreen component tests created (wrapped in MemoryRouter). 1 additional resourceHistory test added to useMissionControl.test.ts. Build exits 0, all 91 tests pass.
